claim_text: Our Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions decreased from FY24 to FY25, despite FY25 being the first full year of gold production.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: Direct FY24–FY25 quantitative evidence is not available because FY25 Scope 1, Scope 2, and emissions intensity values in the ESG Data Pack are marked “TBD in September”. Therefore, the claim cannot be clearly verified using the available data.
